SCORE: SMITH’S RULE FOR SEQUENTIAL SEARCH
Each try succeeds with chance p and costs c.
Descending p/c gives the lowest expected cost
Cache penalty 2: FRED, whose terms forbid storing.
Order is configuration, generated by waterfall.py.
ORDER FOR EVERY RESOURCE (SCORE IN BRACKETS)
Designed, not built. The code today has one
1. A layer counts only if every required field is present. Otherwise the next layer runs.
2. One answer comes from one layer. Fields are never mixed across layers.
3. Missing optional fields stay null. The domain skips that metric and says so.
